question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 32000 for 6 months at 12% per annum compounded quarterly?
solution:
Given:

Sum = Rs. 32000

Rate = 12%

Time = 6 month

Concept used:

 A = P(1 + ({r)/()}{100})t{}

Interest = A - P

A = amount

P = principal or sum

r = rate of interest

t = time

For quarterly interest 

Rate = r/4

Time = (4 × t)/12

Calculation:

Interest rate for quarterly = 12/4 = 3%

Time = 4 × (6/12) = 2

So,

A = 32000(1 + 3/100)²

⇒ A = 32000(103/100)2

⇒ A = 32000 × (10609/10000)

⇒ A = 33948.8

So, amount = Rs. 33948.8

Interest = 33948.8 - 32000

⇒ Rs. 1948.8

∴ Required interest is Rs. 1948.8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Compound interest on Rs. 32000 for 6 months

⇒ 32000(1 + (12)/(4 × 100))⁴ times frac{⁶ {12}} - 32000

⇒ 32000 × 1.03² - 32000

⇒ Rs. 1948.8

**∴ The compound interest on Rs. 32000 for 6 months at 12% per annum compounded quarterly is Rs. 1948.8.**
